products.product_description: Bornstein Frozen Shrimp Meat, Wild Caught - Product of USA. Product is cooked and Ready-To-Eat. Processed in the USA by Bornstein Seafoods Inc. Astoria, OR. The following items are being recalled: ZMU41-1003 Fzn Shrimp Meat 250/350 Ct 15 X 1lb. bag (net wt. 15lb) ZMU41-1007 Fzn Shrimp Meat 250/350 Ct 4 X 5lb. bag (net wt. 20lb) ZMU41-1015 Fzn Shrimp Meat 350/500 Ct 15 X 1lb. bag (net wt. 15lb) ZMU41-1019 Fzn Shrimp Meat 350/500 Ct 4 X 5lb bag (net wt. 20lb) ZMU41-1020 Fzn Shrimp Meat 350/500 Ct 20lb bag (net wt. 20lb) ZMU41-1045 Fzn Shrimp Meat 250/350 Ct 20lb bag (net wt. 20lb)
products.reason_for_recall: The recall was the result of the firm's routine sampling program and Listeria monocytogenes was detected in an in-process shrimp sample in a food production environment.
